text:
BIG-IP LTM v16.0.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 16.0.0
Commands Updated in BIG-IP LTM 16.0.0
CATEGORY::lookup
- returns a list of categories returned by the categorization engine
DIAMETER::persist
- returns the persistence key being used for the current message
HTTP::version
- returns or sets the HTTP version of the request or response
SIP::persist
- returns or replaces the persistence key being used for the current message
SSL::forward_proxy
- sets the SSL forward proxy bypass feature to bypass or intercept
table
- interface for the session table
